name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán Kovács is a seasoned marketing coordinator with a passion for motorsport that ignited during his youth, attending local rally events in Hungary. He began his career in advertising, quickly specializing in sports marketing, before transitioning to motorsport full-time. Zoltán believes in a data-driven approach, always seeking innovative ways to engage fans and sponsors alike.

His demanding nature stems from a desire for excellence. He meticulously plans campaigns, expecting precision and dedication from his team. Zoltán is known for his ability to see the big picture, crafting comprehensive strategies that align with the team's long-term goals. His loyalty to Toyota Gazoo Racing BR is unwavering, stemming from a deep respect for the brand's legacy and commitment to innovation.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Zoltán is a stocky man with a commanding presence and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a lucky pen that he uses for signing important documents.
Insists on starting every meeting exactly on time.
Has a collection of vintage rally car posters in his office.
